goal: Prevent file descriptor leaks into child processes like external signers or notification scripts
Ensure files opened across platforms are marked non-inheritable by default
agreement: Substantive support with all prior objections resolved
Verified on Windows that opened files lack inheritance flags (ValeraFinebits)
Initial race condition concern in multithreaded file opening was addressed (hebasto)

why: P3 because it hardens shared file opening primitives against descriptor leaks into child processes
